## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and link the issue, if any.

## Validation

List relevant tests and any manual installation/connector checks. Distinguish mocked provider tests from real delivery.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Matching uncertainty, metric meaning and source attribution remain accurate.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; schema changes include a reversible migration.
- [ ] User/contributor docs reflect the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private inventories or generated database files are included.
- [ ] Risks, limitations and compatibility changes are documented.
